causes.label: demand
causes.quote: The maximum temperature in Brisbane reached around 33 degrees as forecast. This was the fourth consecutive day of temperatures above 30 degrees. Maximum total demand for the day reached 8996 MW.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Actual demand was lower than forecast (see section 3.1.2).

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Electricity demand, during the 5 pm trading interval was lower than forecast 12 hours ahead.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: As can be seen, actual total demand was significantly lower than forecast demand 4 hours ahead, leading to lower than forecast high prices.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: The figure shows that, with such a tight supply and demand curve, small increases in 5-minute demand coincided with increases in price.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The transfer of electricity across the QNI interconnector was limited by constraints to around 200 MW.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Constraints on Terranora were forcing around 100 MW of flow into New South Wales for the duration of trading intervals priced above $5000/MWh, slightly higher than forecast.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: During the time of the high prices, imports into Queensland on these interconnectors were limited to a maximum of around 100 MW.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The ability to transfer electricity from neighbouring regions of the NEM was significantly constrained due to limitations in the network.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: These limitations prevented other cheaper sources of electricity from competing with generation in Queensland and remaining local demand had to be met by local generation.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding reduced the amount of capacity priced between $500/MWh and $12 500/MWh such that, depending on circumstances, the price could change significantly in response to minor changes to demand or supply.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: The high price of the 1.05 pm dispatch interval can be attributed to this behaviour, where Callide and Alinta rebid 364 MW of generation capacity to $13 400/MWh and above.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding of capacity from high to low priced bands in response to a high dispatch price - It is not unusual for generators to seek to increase revenue by rebidding capacity to low price bands to facilitate higher dispatch levels during the high priced trading interval, for example in the 1.30 pm trading interval.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 4.50 pm the dispatch price reached $12 499/MWh following this price there was little capacity rebid from high to low prices by Queensland participants.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: There was no significant rebidding of capacity from high to low prices by other participants.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: For the 5.30 pm trading interval generators did not rebid their capacity to lower prices and the resulting price was close to the high forecast price.
